notes.title: Update 1.057: Italiano, Deutsch, Čeština is live!
notes.notes:
Greetings, friends!

This update adds full Italian, German, and Czech localizations to the game. We are also continuing to fix small bugs and improve performance, plus we've updated the game engine version for a more stable experience.

Please note: the new localizations will continue to be improved in future patches. If you find any mistakes or issues, let us know on Steam or by email: support@atomrpg.com

Thank you for your support!

ATOM RPG: Trudograd Release Date Reveal
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/3e686c9fbc98c5bf004a0b94e3754b3a26645c92.jpg

Dear friends!

Finally the moment has come when we can announce the release date for ATOM RPG: Trudograd.

This event will happen on September 13th, 2021. 

Until then we will use every minute available playtesting the game, fixing bugs, checking out different PC configurations and planning for upcoming content patches.

Spending more than a year in Early Access we have once again found that you, our players, are the greatest source of motivation and inspiration. Your support means the world to us. Your critiques, ideas, advice, the help you offered in bug fixing, planning new features and perfecting mechanics, are what Trudograd would never survive without.

It is thanks to you that Trudograd, initially planned as a small DLC, grew into a game with tens of hours of content, new features, and interesting new ways to play. Original voiced text quests, new skill tree, new locations and characters, perfected balance are just a few of the things you helped us reach. 

It is only natural that we wish to thank you for going above and beyond in helping us. That’s why everyone who owned Trudograd in Early Access will get a small free DLC gift called the Veteran’s Pack which will include a new uniform, a Veteran’s medal and a pretty nifty little thermos that will help you in your travels.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/0b1508ff56ea5e8fe9e5e311c0e1a0f8e4283003.png
Thank you again for your support, trust and patience. And as always, let there be… ATOM!

See you on the release date!

notes.title: Patch 0.9.1
Update v.0.9
April Update ver. 0.8.1
Trudograd: Road to Release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/c8f3433c86adbd05d8f7fe2f55859ea5db7938c7.jpg

Greetings, friends!

Since the last update, we have released a fair few patches and continued actively working on the new batch of content. Together with that, we’re trying to always be there to read your amazing feedback and cooperate on the features, fixes and changes you recommend. 

All in all, we have come a very long way since the start of the Early Access, and right now we’re giving it our all to improve the already made parts of the game, and add new ones as the plot demands it. 

Seeing how this is a very hard process that’s also very difficult to track, we decided to share our Roadmap with you, so that you always be able to see where we’re at in the development process.

This roadmap contains general information about the work we have already done, as well as about the features and content we’re planning for the release. It doesn’t include post-release support, because we’re never setting an expiration date on that part of development, as some of you already know.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/767eeecfca7270c9e9cc41accbaf88cd602814fd.jpg

April

We’ll start off with a big content update. 

Afterwards, we’ll continue adding to the game, focusing more and more on the main plot line. New characters will appear in the Outskirts, Grey Corner, Factory, Mikhalych’s Tavern, Police, Docks, Kolotushkin Str. Plus, we’re already adding the first people for the upper tier of the city. 

April will also be a month we rebalance some of the weapons and skills; we’ll also continue working on visuals and soundscape. 

May-June

All of our team’s strength will be used to finalize the main story line and the mechanics that are already in the game. We’ll then work on some of the yet unintroduced mechanics you asked us for, and add to some special locations we’re not willing to spoil just yet :)

After the big update planned for this time period, you will finally be able to finish the game! 

The development process won’t stop there, however, since it’s not all about the main plot. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/3f52cc6a319abe7d131941d9ddcd3dc1e33b64bc.jpg

July

After finishing the main storyline in all of its forms, we will expand the roster of side quests and plot unrelated locations. We’ll set to finalize the Lighthouse, the Caves, the new bunker and we’ll add to the locations that already exist.

August

Random encounters and adventure maps will receive new additions in this part of the work process. We’ll also add a few special side quest lines and characters to the upper and lower tier locations. 

September

This month will be used to stabilize and finalize the game before release. It’s the last month for finishing all major additions to the game, making the last icons, objects, sets of armor, loading screens, etc. We’ll also finalize the trade and combat balance. 

IMPORTANT: Before the release hits, we’ll have to wipe the old save files, to ensure the correct compatibility between the new and old content, as well as optimize the game’s performance.

We wish to deeply apologize for postponing the release. Our communal wish to make Trudograd a really great game brought us before new quality standards, which unfortunately ask for more resources, finances, and most importantly - time. 

Although this was not an easy decision to make, we don’t want to cut the game Trudograd became and wish to tell its story to the fullest. We value your support and understanding over all else. Thank you for being with us. 

And let there be ATOM!

notes.title: V0.8: The Special Armor Update!
New Update and Live Stream Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

Today we wanted to make several announcements.

Firstly, we are very happy that the reception of last week's update was so positive.
But thanks to some of your more critical feedback we also see what we can do better moving forward. So keep on sending us your ideas. This is the fuel that keeps us going!

We will try to implement some of the smaller suggestions in the next patch, but the bigger ones will have to wait for the next huge update.
By the way, we already started working on it and are ready to shed a little bit of light on the new content that will be available in it.

You will be able to visit the upper (or rather rooftop) city, a place that is different from the lower slums not only in living standards, but also quests and encounters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/09d5a0718b40c4861a8a09d60afde1f1d5ceeaef.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/75117c519a556e01a390e6e57f90dd1f5c365e26.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/ece6f17693d772883898a8f3137a05a31f4955b2.jpg

Also, special armour and weapons will get new enchantments. As well as a new quest for those who bought the finest armor in all of Trudograd.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/e5d77ebaae58a797b4f21e88e616aedc9f4b72d4.jpg

Moreover, we want to add a couple of improvements to the UI. For example: write the name of the active object if you press ALT, add some features to the global map, etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/ebbe7a7c737993c15decf90aa4f0e392fefefcb9.jpg

It will be very interesting to hear your opinion when we will present you with those new features.

***

At the moment, Atom RPG: Trudograd has been in Early Access for six months, but during this time it has outgrow our initial plan for a small story expansion. Now it’s shaping out to be a real game with many new characters and quests, made with a new level of quality.

Of course, this transformation required significantly more time than we originally planned for, but we hope that it will pay off in the most important thing - creating the kind of game that you expect from us!

We plan to release the full game in the beginning of 2021. Hopefully not even reaching a year in Early Access :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/7fbadb95cebc20833ccc823eefe6904d6c7adf74.jpg

Also, for those of you who are interested we want to announce that we will be having a live Q&A on YouTube!

We rarely have time for something like that, but we wanted to finally interact with you, guys. English stream will be held on December 12, Saturday; at 16:00 Eastern Time Zone.

~STREAM~

Take care and let there be Atom!

notes.title: Update 0.7: Special Armor Edition
Next big update announcement
notes.notes:
Hey, guys!

Work on the next big update for the Early Access is going as planned, that’s why we decided it’s high time we announce some of our work to prepare you for what awaits in the future ;) 

First off, new plot related missions are being prepared to take you to new locations and make you meet exciting new characters. New random encounters are also being added to the city map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/6bc68e166825e642ee7352aa77c6426dfc19c916.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/fd4a777b84cd36c3cd8dc8f76aa70a39ed60b738.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/091237587dd9d50fce9a524ad1ca35136df46256.jpg

Old locations are getting new life. The last bit is especially true for the city docks area. There will be also plenty of new sidequests for those who want to take a break from the plot!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/6dcd899716cf9daf70f70323158cfe843fdebb15.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/44af91f3364799af5d0efb550885959ebb51b5ab.jpg

The characters will be revamped to new graphics standards with much more distinct facial features, and we’re not talking about portraits. The new facial detalization system is almost implemented into the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/f1b651b9a22485bd87797333162edf67b218568e.png

This new feature along with new animations will surely set the bar higher for Trudograd graphics-wise. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/b8ddf08307a054aafbe2cfcb50834f0d9bd146c2.jpg

We really hope that these new visuals will be to your liking, and we’d love to hear your critiques on this matter. 

The combat system was perfected with new features and tweaks to balance, inspired by you, our amazing community. Combat is still a work in progress, though, so some of it might change in an update or two. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/bbe338538a5e53b80cdf70a51a02bf966411ca00.jpg

And of course, this update will be the first one ever to feature the… On the other hand, let’s not ruin the surprise ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/b85bca1407b0e2f08bb2b79bb39d69a7145aa0be.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/d1e7a9553d56eea4a5c0e927695b2ff4fd0e91d5.jpg
WIP

Stay tuned, friends. We’re thankful as ever for your unending support.

Have a spooky Samhain! 

And as always… Let there be ATOM!

notes.title: 0.6.73 Bug fixes

Today we're uploading a small yet important Early Access patch which fixes follower behavior on the cargo ship, as well as initiative mechanics in combat. Also, this patch fixes a lot of bugs you guys helped us uncover since the last big update. 
Thank you for your support, and let there be ATOM!

notes.title: 0.6.72 Bug fixes
Newest content update
News About The Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/135e435d8f55b058b2076b2185b37a8ce07680a0.jpg
Greetings, friends!

Today we would like to share some information about the upcoming update for ATOM RPG: Trudograd, which will be published in the near future!

In the upcoming update, you will get to visit new locations -including the city port and a giant ship in the open sea- with their unique characters, quests and merchants, as well as find new additions to locations you already visited in the current version of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/0b9cf047833a5c4b46c50dd3ae92c0223ad4ed07.jpg

The plot will be expanded with lots of new adventures, in which you will be offered a role of an action movie hero, get to meet an entirely new faction of characters, and get sent into a den of vile cultists!

Also, you will now be able to join the city police. Unless you completed all three of the revolutionary missions, you will be able to ditch your comrades and join the force (works the other way around as well).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/a847011e35e3398b15120de6b6151b32d087375a.jpg

The two-handed weapons will be finally available in the upcoming update! This unique weapon type not only has its own rules for ignoring armour and dealing critical damage, but also comes with it’s own mechanics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/0d3caad3fbf44f47c05d252701228f49fda32b0c.jpg

After carefully examining the feedback from our players we also made some adjustments to the abilities. We fixed problems with the armour and evasion bonuses, improved the mechanics that give you or your enemy's critical conditions and many, many more.

Naturally, the update will also feature new improvements, bug-fixes, animations, vignette quests, and many more goodies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/e10b88197eedd8cc8e5260b5e3aed81322700f13.jpg

The date of the update will be announced soon. Meanwhile, please check out these screenshots of new things to come!

Thank you for being with us on this journey. And let there be ATOM!
